scope: Direct cooked/raw Rust doc attributes and mixed mapped text on existing owners; Unit1 of #1664

independent_derivations.mixed_margin: Sugared '     hello' has margin five; nonsugared 'another' participates with add=1. Global minimum one removes one from the comment and zero from the attribute: four spaces remain.
independent_derivations.empty_join: Each empty prose fragment contributes an assembly LF; one final assembly LF is removed. Two empty attributes produce one LF.
independent_derivations.same_row: Single-line interiors ' a ' and ' b ' lose their common left space, preserving both right spaces: 'a \nb '. Physical legacy DLOC remains one.
independent_derivations.decoded_crlf: Cooked a\r\nb decodes CR and LF separately. str::lines removes CR; LF output maps only to the complete \n escape. Physical CRLF instead maps to both physical bytes.
independent_derivations.unicode_underscores: Pinned grammar recovers \u{1_f600} into ERROR plus a missing-delimiter value. Production content is GrammarBoundary; the decoder's valid underscore syntax cannot establish lost supplied-tree boundaries.
